name: Ysaere
description:
Ysaere connects Claude to prepaid AI research swarms for Angels and Due Diligence teams.

What you can do
• Run Company Intelligence, Angel / Angel Deep, Market Intelligence, Due Diligence, and Security Assessments
• Check credit balance, poll report status, and fetch provenance (integrity hashes—not a claim of factual truth)

How it works
Remote Streamable HTTP MCP at https://mcp.ysaere.com/mcp. Sign in with OAuth (Client ID: claude.ai; leave Client Secret blank) or use an MCP-enabled API key. Tools that spend credits are marked destructive and open-world: they debit your Ysaere balance and may use live web research.

Requirements
A Ysaere account with credits. Sign up at https://app.ysaere.com. After login, open Developer → MCP Server  https://ysaere.com/mcp/  for setup. Public API reference: https://api.ysaere.com/v1/openapi.json

Legal
Outputs are designed and engineered AI-generated research for informational purposes only—not investment, legal, or professional advice. Terms: https://app.ysaere.com/terms · Privacy: https://app.ysaere.com/privacy

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ysaere to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ysaere to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.ysaere.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ysaere MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ysaere provides these MCP tools: angel_deep_intelligence, angel_intelligence, check_balance, check_report_status, company_intelligence, competitive_intelligence, due_diligence, market_intelligence, security_assessment, verify_provenance, estimate_credits, and wait_for_report.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ysaere?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Ysaere in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Ysaere requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Ysaere is developed by Ysaere, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
